validation_scenarios.name: audience reframe with preserved artifact

validation_scenarios.name: revision synchronization

turns.prompt:
Create a shelter capacity and supply map for a county emergency shelter briefing. This is a presentation artifact, not an interactive dashboard. Keep it as one shelter capacity and supply map in the first viewport.

Situation: Event: river flood. Shelters S-A, S-B, S-C, pet annex, medical cot cache, bus route B7, food vendor, volunteer desk.
Current state: S-A 94% full red, S-B 61% amber, S-C 34% green, pet annex full, medical cot cache 120, B7 route blocked, food vendor ETA 18:00.
Timeline: 10:00 flood warning, 11:30 S-A opens, 13:00 pet annex full, 14:20 B7 blocked, 15:00 cot delivery, 18:00 vendor ETA.
Sources: S1 shelter intake, S2 route status, S3 pet annex log, S4 cot inventory, S5 vendor dispatch, S6 EOC briefing.

Requirements: 1. The first viewport must be dominated by one coherent visual artifact, not a grid of detached KPI cards. 2. Show the main entities, current states, source markers S1-S6, timeline, legend, and four connected callouts. 3. The callouts must cover S-A capacity, pet annex full, B7 blocked, cot cache. 4. Use polished domain-appropriate styling with readable labels and no critical overlap.

Reframe it for the EOC director. Preserve the shelter map; add exactly three actions: divert arrivals to S-C, open pet overflow, reroute B7. Add two leader-linked lenses for cot inventory and food ETA.

Update at 16:10: S-A reaches 100%, S-C rises to 58%, pet overflow opens, B7 reroute active, food vendor slips to 19:15. Recompute visible shelter slack so S-A has 0% remaining capacity and pet overflow becomes the active pet option. Synchronize map, actions, timeline, source tags, callouts, and change note. Do not leave pet annex as the only pet option.
Create a public shelter status page. Fit shelter map, capacity ledger, source tags S1-S6, supply strip, and timeline in the first viewport.

Add a field volunteer briefing card beside the public page. The card must show only field-safe instructions, but still preserve S-A 100% / 0% slack, S-C 58%, pet overflow open, B7 reroute, food 19:15, and source markers. Keep the full public page synchronized beside it.
